explanation: Q1 returns drinkers who only visit bars serving beers they like (NOT EXISTS means no bar serves an unliked beer). Q2 returns drinkers who visit at least one bar serving an unliked beer (EXISTS means at least one such bar exists). They are logical complements and thus not semantically equivalent.
counterexample_dsp: A drinker (Alice) who frequents a bar serving only beers she likes. Q1 returns Alice, Q2 returns nothing. Another drinker (Bob) who frequents a bar serving an unliked beer would be in Q2 but not Q1.
